outcome: Every phase /run agent acts as coordinator, preserves its context window, and delegates coding by area of concern to in-session sub-agents instead of implementing the phase itself.
proof: The /run skill states the coordinator role, keep/delegate split, area-of-concern dispatch, and brief/return contract.
Phase template kickoff tells the agent to coordinate and delegate.
Regression tests fail if the run skill, phase template, or AGENTS.md drop the coordinator contract.
non_goals: No learner behavior, API, content, or runtime change.
Do not start Praxis or a second runner.
Do not change close-gate auditor independence or require publication.
